note: Employer boards for direct-from-source discovery. Every entry below was confirmed read-only on 2026-11-21 by calling the public API and counting postings; `observed` records what was actually returned, not an estimate. Location mix changes constantly, so re-check with `job-agent employers --probe` before trusting `enabled`. Add your own employers here; do not guess board tokens, confirm one by opening the URL first.
finding: Across 1425 postings on these 13 boards only 4 were in Frankfurt/Stuttgart/Heilbronn and 34 including remote-Germany. The Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby ecosystem is Berlin/Munich-centric. Large Frankfurt, Stuttgart and Heilbronn employers mostly run their own portals or SAP SuccessFactors, which is why `career_pages` and the Brave adapter exist.

career_pages.name: EXAMPLE — replace or delete me
career_pages.notes: Add an employer's own careers page here only after checking (1) that its robots.txt permits fetching and (2) that its posting pages publish schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD. The adapter reads only that structured data and never guesses a vacancy out of page text. Many large German employers run SAP SuccessFactors or Workday portals that render jobs with JavaScript and publish no JSON-LD; those cannot be read this way and are not supported.
